content.text: Kora xa die xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba maxase luuti daaxi xui ra.
Mangɛ Alatala, i xa lingira tofan!
N wama sofe i xa tɛtɛ kui n bɔɲɛ birin na.
Na waxɔnyi minima n dɛ i i tan Ala nan bɛ, i tan naxan ɲiɲɛ a ra.
Hali xɔni xunxurie alɔ turunna nun debelinyi
e tɛɛ sama i xa sɛrɛxɛbade sɛɛti ma e xa die luma dɛnnaxɛ.
I tan Alatala Sɛnbɛma, n ma Mangɛ nun n Marigi,
sɛɛwɛ na mixie bɛ, naxee sabatixi i xa banxi kui.
E luma i matɔxɔ ra dɛnnaxɛ abadan. Ɲɛngi rate.
Sɛɛwɛ na mixie bɛ naxee sɛnbɛ lanxi i tan Ala ma,
naxee kira suxuxi sigafe ra salide xungbe.
E Baka gulunba igirima tɛmui naxɛ,
e ye dulonyie to nɛ, tunɛ ye gbegbe bara naa rafe.
E keli yire fanyi nde, e siga yire fanyi gbɛtɛ.
E na birin to nɛ kira xɔn sigafe ra Ala yire
e e yɛtɛ masen a bɛ dɛnnaxɛ.
N Marigi Alatala Sɛnbɛma, n ma dubɛ suxu!
Yaxuba Marigi Ala, i n ma maxandi ramɛ. Ɲɛngi rate.
Ala, hinnɛ i xa mixi sugandixi ra
naxan findixi muxu xa wure lefa ra.
Xi keren nadangife i xa banxi kui,
na ɲɔxun dangife xi wulu wulu ra yire gbɛtɛ.
N lufe i xa banxi dɛ ra, na fan lufe ra tinxintaree xɔnyi,
barima Ala Xungbe findixi won ma kantari nan na,
a hinnɛ nun binyɛ fima nɛ won ma.
A mu tondima tinxintaree kide hɛɛri ra.
Marigi Sɛnbɛma, hɛɛri na mixi bɛ naxan a yɛtɛ taxuma i ra.
